description: The packages (haiccing/base-package-<name>), as the package manager writes them from this repository's modules: each a set of modules, self-contained, with what it requires. third-party is imported from the workspace's installed tree (pkgm import); the others are written from the modules (pkgm write).

third-party.description: The third-party code below mycelium, not ours: Bare's runtime and modules, the Holepunch stack, isomorphic-git, React and htm. Imported once from the development workspace (the one contact with npm), Linux x64 only, recorded in third-party.json.

mycelium.description: The repository layer: layered git repositories (mycelium-git, -layer, -repo), topics, URIs and paths; with p2p-git, git on Hyperdrive, which mycelium-git runs on.

haicc.description: HAICC: declare what a project needs, check it, make it so (haicc-reconcile), its lifecycle (haicc-deployment), and its boot (haicc-base-boot). The entry: everything starts here.
readme: Linux on x86-64 (on Windows: inside WSL2), with `curl` and `tar`. The setup is this package's release, `haicc-setup.sh`:
sh haicc-setup.sh ~/haicc-work         # a work folder: haiccing/ with boot, sources and this package
~/haicc-work/haiccing/boot             # the root: Node.js, HAICC's root part, then git and Docker checked

The boot runs in two stages. Stage 1, `haiccing/boot`, in plain shell: Linux x86-64 and Node.js (Node.js fixed with your yes, into `.haicc/node`); the root's part of HAICC (`haicc-base-boot`) copied into `.haicc/`; `./haicc` written. Stage 2, `./haicc boot`: the host's other prerequisites (git 2.25 or later; Docker Engine installed, running, rootful, native, and you in the `docker` group), each fixed only with your yes (`--yes` agrees beforehand); then `haiccing/install` if there (one `./haicc` command a line), or the next commands. Everything it prints goes to `.haicc/log/haicc.log` too.
The rest of HAICC (`haicc-reconcile`, `haicc-deployment`) runs in managers: each swarm self-contained, with its own HAICC, package manager and packages (`./haicc boot <manager>`, next).

pkgm.description: The package manager: packages as self-contained folders, installed into the host's install folder, tested within the package. Node's built-ins only.
readme: By HAICC's boot (`haiccing/boot` in a work folder, from `base-package-haicc`), with its own code, into the work folder's `.haicc/packages`; HAICC is then installed by it. There is no boot of its own: everything starts at HAICC.

p2p.description: The p2p substrate, ours: store, discovery, connections, replication, channels, repositories on Hypercore, the name service, the node and its managers.

splectral.description: The Splectral platform: the server, its shell, the contract and model, transports, and the extensions for p2p swarms (watchers, actions, observer), scenarios, the timeline and replay; the map view (splectral/base-view-map), shared by the demos.

demo-liveness.description: Demo project: A node goes quiet. Its project (project.json) and its Splectral component (splectral/base-demo-liveness).

demo-other-host.description: Demo project: A node on another host. Its project (project.json) and its Splectral component (splectral/base-demo-other-host).
